title: Issue Ops Suite Settings
description: Configure notification recipients, critical spent-time boundaries, and the GitHub repository used for action tracking.

notificationEmails.title: Notification recipients
notificationEmails.description: Comma-separated email addresses that receive critical spent-time alerts and manual email actions.

notificationsEnabled.title: Send notifications
notificationsEnabled.description: Turn off to keep monitoring and logging without sending any email.

criticalSpentTimeMinutes.title: Critical spent-time limit (minutes)
criticalSpentTimeMinutes.description: Default critical boundary for total spent time. Per-issue and per-project overrides set in the Critical Threshold Configurator take precedence.

warningPercentage.title: Warning threshold (% of limit)
warningPercentage.description: Total spent time at or above this percentage of the critical limit reports the WARNING status.

alertRepeatMinutes.title: Alert repeat interval (minutes)
alertRepeatMinutes.description: Minimum number of minutes between two alerts for the same issue.

githubRepository.title: GitHub repository
githubRepository.description: Repository in owner/name form that is scanned for pull requests referencing the issue ID.

githubApiBaseUrl.title: GitHub API base URL
githubApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the GitHub REST API. Use https://api.github.com for github.com.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Personal access token with read access to pull requests and actions.
